statement: You are given an integer array nums.
Consider every contiguous subarray of nums and take its minimum element. Add all of these minimums together.

examples.explanation: Of the ten subarrays, only [71] and [82] have a minimum other than 55: 71 + 82 + 8 × 55 = 593.
The single elements give 3 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 10. The pairs give 1 + 1 + 2 = 4, the triples 1 + 1 = 2, and the whole array 1, for 17 in total.
